notes:
REF-BM-02: Title, description, and favicon are collected, but no preview image is extracted or stored.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are prevented, but the user is silently redirected to the existing detail page rather than guided into editing it.
REF-BM-08: List-item titles navigate to an internal detail page, not directly to the original URL.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain text field with no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-11: Displayed tags are not selectable and no dedicated tag-filter control is implemented.
REF-BM-14: The parser supports tag:tag syntax, not the required #tag syntax.
REF-BM-20: Bulk add-tag, read/unread, archive, and delete exist, but bulk tag removal is missing.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed, but markdown is rendered as plain text.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML/PDF snapshot capture or storage is implemented.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support is implemented.
REF-BM-29: No saved bundles or reusable included/excluded-tag filters are implemented.
REF-BM-30: No Netscape HTML import is implemented.
REF-BM-31: No Netscape HTML export is implemented.
REF-BM-32: No personal display-settings interface or persistence is implemented.
